scope: Read-only metadata inventory of the fixed official Windows QEMU package. No QEMU, helper or installer execution; no VNC, credentials, dependency/PATH, route, firewall or protection changes.

source.note: Upstream-listed Windows build, not an upstream reproducible build attestation. Installer is only extracted on disposable Windows CI; never executed.

interpretation: Helper absence is an inventory fact, not proof Windows cmd forwarding is unsupported. Helper search behavior depends on the bundled GLib version and directory layout; no spawn/fd test is executed here.
